overview: The Medford Traffic Commission reviewed resident parking and traffic safety requests, approving a handicap parking sign, referring a dangerous intersection on Fulton Street to engineering, and directing staff to update resident permit signage near Chevalier Theatre.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The Commission approved the amended minutes from the previous meeting.

items.title: Permit Parking Variance: Forest Street
items.summary: Resident Jennifer Corrales requested permission to park on an adjacent street due to Chevalier Theatre events crowding Forest Street. The Commission voted to direct the engineering department to review and update Forest Street signage to protect resident permit parking overnight.

items.title: Handicap Parking Application: 51 Metcalf Street
items.summary: The Commission approved a petition for an on-street handicap parking sign in front of 51 Metcalf Street.

items.title: Stop Sign Request: Fulton Street and Winslow Avenue
items.summary: Petitioner Alex Genovese requested an all-way stop or blinking red light to address speeding and blind turns at Fulton and Winslow. The Commission referred the matter to the Traffic and Engineering Department for formal review and recommendations while police committed to placing speed trailers in the area.

items.title: Commission Business and Summer Schedule
items.summary: Commissioners discussed tracking previously approved measures, improving website guidance for public inquiries, parking constraints associated with residential development, and scheduling a daytime summer working session to review operating rules.
